table_frozen_since.verified: 2026-10-02 全提交历史逐位比对（16 条值集合 hash 6ea490e946 恒定）

source_classes.STANDARD: 数值可溯源到具名公开标准
source_classes.EXPERIMENTAL: 数值由仓库内 lab 实验推导（auditory.lab / physics 校准线）
source_classes.DEFAULT: 仓库内工程默认值，尚无校准证据

true_peak_margin_reduced.source: Engineering margin on the ITU-R BS.1770 true-peak measurement; delivery practice (EBU R128 / streaming -1 dBTP ceilings) informs the direction, but the 0.5 dB early-warning margin was chosen in-repo.

excessive_loudness_increase.source: Engineering default. LUFS measurement is ITU-R BS.1770; the 4 LU relative-increase risk level comes from neither a standard nor a repo experiment.

excessive_dynamic_compression.source: Engineering default on crest-factor dynamics; the 4 dB reduction level is not calibrated against listening evidence. Lab DYNAMIC_COMPRESSION ladders exist but no derivation has been performed.

crest_factor_collapse.source: Engineering default absolute crest floor; no standard defines a crest floor and no experiment derived 4 dB.

new_clipping.source: Definitional invariant: any new full-scale sample is flagged. The value is fixed by definition; calibration is not applicable.

low_frequency_overaccumulation.source: Engineering default for low-band energy-ratio growth; no calibration experiment performed.

high_frequency_overaccumulation.source: Engineering default for high-band energy-ratio growth; no calibration experiment performed.

new_high_frequency_cutoff.source: Engineering default for cutoff reduction; lab LOWPASS ladders can produce crossing stimuli but no derivation has been performed.

stereo_phase_risk_increased.source: Engineering default; the phase-risk metric is repo-defined (no external standard), threshold not calibrated.

negative_correlation_increased.source: Engineering default; negative-correlation ratio is a repo-defined proxy, threshold not calibrated.

duration_changed.source: Engineering tolerance; mirrors DURATION_TOLERANCE_S in auditory/comparison.py (AS-001 rescan consistency), not derived from a standard.

channel_layout_changed.source: Definitional invariant: channel identity must be preserved. Calibration is not applicable.

sample_rate_changed.source: Definitional invariant: sample rate must be preserved. Calibration is not applicable.

silence_structure_changed.source: Engineering default for silence-ratio change; lab SILENCE_INSERT ladders exist but no derivation has been performed.

invalid_audio_samples.source: Definitional invariant: non-finite (NaN/Inf) audio samples are defects. Calibration is not applicable.

analysis_confidence_low.source: Engineering default measurement-health gate; the 0.999 finite-sample floor was chosen in-repo.

calibration_summary.note: 阈值来源化（Layer C）只记录信任级别，不重校准数值；DEFAULT_UNCALIBRATED 的阈值是工程默认值，不得当作经过听感校准的限值消费。
